Overview

A closer look

The nTrust Portal gives your team a single, real-time view of every nTrust solution you run. See posture at a glance, track open findings, monitor compliance status, and export organized evidence packages when auditors come knocking.

Portal access is provisioned for early-access participants as part of onboarding. Our team will help you activate your workspace.

Capabilities

What you get

📊

Posture Overview

A live summary of security and compliance posture across your estate.

📅

Compliance Calendar

Know exactly when assessments, renewals and evidence refreshes are due.

📦

Evidence Library

Browse and export timestamped evidence for every control, on demand.

🔔

Alert Center

Review findings and alerts with clear priority and owner assignment.

📈

Trend Reporting

Track improvement over time with board-ready trend views.

🔒

Secure Access

Role-based access with SSO-ready authentication and full session audit.

Who it’s for

  • Active customers monitoring their nTrust deployments.
  • Compliance officers exporting evidence for audits.
  • Executives reviewing posture trends between board cycles.

Compliance alignment

Every nTrust solution is engineered with enterprise-grade security from day one and maps to the frameworks your organization operates under:

  • NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage)
  • EU AI Act transparency & logging obligations
  • ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control alignment
  • GDPR and CCPA privacy requirements
